snippet.title: J's Racin' - PS1 Gameplay
snippet.description:
J's Racin' - Gameplay

J's Racin' is a Japanese exclusive racing game, developed by TYO and published by Digital Frontier in 1997.

0:00 Intro
3:14 Car Selection Screen
4:02 Race 1 - Sendai Hi-Land Raceway
9:32 Race 2 -  T.I. Circuit Aida
14:51 Race 3 - Sportsland Sugo
19:49 Race 4 - Fuji Speedway

NOTE: Recorded in the original 4:3 aspect ratio and original game graphics (no filters, shaders etc...)
